title: gentianella quinquefolia var. occidentalis
intro: Gentianella quinquefolia var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western gentianella, is a plant species in the gentian family that is native to western North America. Western gentianella has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Western gentianella include its bitter properties, which can stimulate digestion and increase appetite, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Western gentianella include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and loganic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
